name: git-commit-assistant
description: Draft Conventional Commit messages and create focused git commits from the current diff.

interface.longDescription: Bundle the draft-commit-message and commit-changes skills for turning the current git diff into a focused Conventional Commit. Draft a message only, or select relevant files, check likely privacy leakage, and create a commit.
defaultPrompt: Draft a commit message for this change
Write a Conventional Commit message from the diff
